messages.author: fecbe3dc811bed89
messages.subject: nominal model constraint
parts:
Hi Phil,

The nominal model in manual reads the ak0=0 and ak(k-1)=k-1 are constraints and allowing the a1 parameter to be estimated. In my interest, I would like to have ak0=0 and a1=1 and allow the ak(k-1) to be estimated. How to implement it in mirt? Thanks.

messages.author: 70d0917afd869432
messages.subject: Re: nominal model constraint
parts:
Hi KK,

You want to use the nominal.highlow parameter in your mirt() call.

For example,

# Set the nominal high/low matrix for 15 questions, with 2 as "high" and 1 as "low", and freely estimate the remaining categories.
nominal.highlow <- matrix(c(rep(2, 15), rep(1, 15)), 2, byrow = TRUE)   

Then, when you call mirt, do something like: 
mirt(data = dat, 1, itemtype = "nominal", nominal.highlow = nominal.highlow)

Of course, you don't have to use rep() and can set the high/low categories on an item by item basis.
